question: Are Old Snowy Mountain North Route and West Route real distinct routes?
answer: Not established. All documented ascents use the PCT/Snowgrass Flat approach to the northwest ridge (some call it 'North Ridge', which is the same finish). Other lines logged are ski/glacier ones from the McCall Glacier side. The PCT runs on the west slopes, so 'West Route' is the same trail line. No source names a separate North or West Route.
recommendation: Delete both stubs (the North Ridge logs belong to the existing Northwest Ridge / PCT row). If the owner wants the McCall Glacier ski line, add it as a new winter ski row after separate research.
evidence: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Old_Snowy_Mountain — easiest route scramble; PCT on west slopes; no other routes
